declared_gaps.text: School holidays for Seoul are not in the pinned registry: the installed Asia edition 3b20667d… lists KR:seoul as a curated host but carries no KR:seoul holiday row and no KR:seoul coverage row, so no school row is stored and the Seoul calendar layer carries public holidays only (20 KR rows from the 2027 월력요항). Seoul school dates are published per school through NEIS, one school year at a time; no 2027 Seoul-wide vacation calendar was found at 2026-11-28 (the 서울특별시교육청 index served a NetFunnel queue shell and its notice list returned no 학사일정 page). The dated, scoped finding is recorded in the store's coverage rows; no Osaka, Tokyo or Kyoto school row was substituted.

The three local-requirement claims record Seoul's language channels, the national alcohol licensing route and Seoul's food-service permit route. None of them says which licence a given venue holds, whether a 50-person private event is covered, or who would hold it: alcohol service and external catering stay unknown on every room. Two captured venue pages do address it — the DDP organiser guide requires prior approval for food and prior discussion for any alcohol brought in, and 몽상가들 스페이스 states that food and alcohol brought in need separate consultation — but neither says who holds a licence.

Six of the sixteen rooms carry operator-published room photographs (12 hotlinked images: DDP 서울-온 화상스튜디오 ×3, COEX 스튜디오 159 ×3, 마로니에공원 다목적홀 ×1, 노들섬 라이브하우스 ×3, 노들섬 노들라운지 ×1, KT&G 상상마당 라이브홀 ×1); ten keep an explicit withheld record with the reason (DDP 디자인홀, DDP 잔디사랑방, COEX 컨퍼런스룸 300, 판교 대회의실, 판교 국제회의장, 몽상가들 서브 세미나룸, 스페이스쉐어 컨퍼런스 B룸, 성공 스페이스, and COCOC 대강당 + 컨퍼런스룸 A, whose published photographs returned 200 at first check and 403 from the operator host on recheck). No Wikimedia image was used: no Commons file on a captured page depicts one of these hired rooms. The 공유누리 hall photograph is published only at 349x262 and is recorded at that size, not upscaled.

Sixteen records sit on ten distinct points. Eight records tier building (DDP ×3, 판교 ×2, 노들섬 라이브하우스, 상상마당 빌딩, 대화빌딩), seven tier street (COCOC ×2 on the 강남대로53길 way, COEX ×2 on a 513 영동대로 point that resolves to a restaurant at that address, 몽상가들 on 8 문래북로, 노들섬 노들라운지 on the island address, 성공 스페이스 on the 왕십리로 way) and 마로니에공원 다목적홀 is area tier (the park). 성공 스페이스 stays a road-segment point after seven Nominatim and four Overpass lookups, all stored. No room entrance was verified anywhere.

Seven 2027 calendar rows were merged from the approved bundle; the page recommends no date and none is booked. KBW2027, UDC, Korea Fintech Week 2027, Seoul Fintech Week 2027, Seoul Fashion Week 2027 F/W and an ETH Seoul 2027 edition have no announced date, so they are carried as notes rather than rows. Three of the seven rows are AI-relevant (AI EXPO KOREA 2027, AI Summit Seoul & Expo 2027, Physical AI EXPO KOREA 2027 at Songdo); the rest are city events used as collision context.

Five of the sixteen records carry no readable price (COEX 컨퍼런스룸 300, COEX 스튜디오 159, KT&G 상상마당 라이브홀, 스페이스쉐어 컨퍼런스 B룸, 성공 스페이스) and their cost is unknown rather than zero; three more record an eight-hour estimate from an hourly rate. USD figures use ECB 2026-11-27 (1 KRW = USD 0.00074912).

The five programme-wide mandatory discovery sources (Miragather ×3, AI Tinkerers, the DeAI Luma feed) carry no check date in this store: the Seoul research bundle recorded no pass against them, and the page prints that fact rather than an assumed read.

alcohol.quote: 제5조(주류 판매업면허) ① 주류 판매업(판매중개업 또는 접객업을 포함한다. 이하 같다)을 하려는 자는 대통령령 으로 정하는 주류 판매업의 종류별로 판매장마다 대통령령 으로 정하는 시설기준과 그 밖의 요건을 갖추어 관할 세무서장의 면허를 받아야 한다. ② 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자가 대통령령 으로 정하는 바에 따라 관할 세무서장에게 주류 판매에 관한 신고를 한 경우에는 제1항에 따른 주류 판매업의 면허(이하 “주류 판매업면허”라 한다)를 받은 것으로 본다. 1. 「식품위생법」 에 따른 영업허가를 받은 장소에서 주류 판매업을 하는 자

alcohol.source_title: 「주류 면허 등에 관한 법률」 제5조(주류 판매업면허) [시행 2026. 7. 1.] [법률 제21716호, 2026. 6. 2., 일부개정] — 국가법령정보센터

value.alcohol_at_food_premises: 국세청 prints that among 식품접객업 only 일반음식점, 단란주점 and 유흥주점 may serve alcohol; 휴게음식점 and 위탁급식 cannot hold the 유흥음식점 deemed licence. A hired hall is not itself a licensed 영업장, so whether the venue's own food licence reaches the room is a per-venue question these pages do not answer.
value.authority: 국세청 (the licence is granted and administered by 관할 세무서장 under 「주류 면허 등에 관한 법률」 제5조, 시행 2026-07-01; the 국세청 주류면허 신청 가이드북 restates the deemed route and the 식품접객업 categories)
value.competent_desk: The competent desk is the competent tax office (관할 세무서장) for the venue address, to be confirmed. The captured pages print no district-to-office table, so this claim assigns no ward, district or venue to any particular 세무서.
value.deemed_route_scope: 국세청 prints that the deemed route is opened by a 「식품위생법」 영업허가 place selling alcohol — the 유흥음식점 route — and by a shop of the 백화점·슈퍼마켓·편의점 kind for 일반소매; a food business whose category does not allow drinking cannot use the 유흥음식점 route.
value.licensing_route: Selling alcohol is 주류 판매업 (the law includes 판매중개업 and 접객업 in that term): a person who wants to carry it on must hold a 주류 판매업면허 for the licence type and for each 판매장, granted by 관할 세무서장. Where the place already holds a 「식품위생법」 영업허가 and sells alcohol there, a 신고 to 관할 세무서장 deems the licence granted (주류 판매업면허의 의제).
value.not_established: These pages do not say who holds the licence for a private event in a hired hall, whether complimentary drinks with no sale fall under 주류 판매업, whether a hired hall can be a 판매장, what the fee and lead time are, or whether a hotel's or caterer's existing licence covers a hired room.
value.who_must_hold_it: The holder is the party carrying on the 주류 판매업 at the 판매장 — in the authority's words, '주류 판매업을 하려는 자' or the 「식품위생법」 영업허가 holder that sells there. Which party that is for a 50-person private event (the venue's own F&B operation, an external caterer, or the organiser) is not settled by these pages and must be fixed in the venue contract.

value.alcohol_with_meals: The same table prints 일반음식점영업 as 음식류 조리·판매 with '식사와 함께 부수적인 음주행위 가능', while 휴게음식점영업 and 제과점영업 print '음주행위 불가' — the food category, not the room, decides whether drinking is allowed on the premises.
value.authority: 서울특별시 시민건강국 식품정책과 (담당부서 and 문의 printed on the page); the permit counter is 구청(위생담당 부서)
value.event_route: Not established by this page: it publishes only the fixed-premises 영업허가/영업신고 route for a licensed 식품접객업 premises and says nothing about a 기간제 or 임시 licence for a one-off event, so no event-food route is asserted for Seoul.
value.fixed_premises: The city prints that 식품접객업 splits into 허가업종 (단란주점업, 유흥주점업) and 신고업종 (휴게·일반음식점, 제과점), that the 처리기관 is 구청(위생담당 부서), that a 허가 is handled in 3 days and a 영업신고 in 3 hours, and it prints the 허가 procedure as 신청서 작성 → 접수 → 서류검토 → 현장실사 및 시설조사 → 결재 → 허가증 교부.
value.licence: 「식품위생법」에 따른 식품접객업 영업허가 (단란주점업·유흥주점업) 또는 영업신고 (휴게·일반음식점, 제과점)
value.not_established: The page does not say who holds the licence for a private event (caterer, venue kitchen or organiser), whether a member-only event with no sale needs any notification, what the fee is, or whether a hotel's or venue kitchen's licence covers catering into a hired room; those stay venue-level questions.

value.city_guidance: Seoul publishes official information for non-Korean speakers through named channels rather than a single register: a five-language telephone service (영어·중국어·일본어·베트남어·몽골어), an English SMS channel, multilingual content planned for the city's own Instagram and blog channels, AI real-time interpretation at eleven major subway stations, multilingual tourist information on VISIT SEOUL, and 생활상담 at 서울글로벌센터.
value.event_implication: For a private community event this is guidance, not an obligation: the city publishes no rule requiring a private event to use any particular language. Providing Korean copy with an English version follows the city's own practice and matches how the city answers a non-Korean-speaking resident.
value.not_established: The release sets no obligation on a private event's language, gives no figure for how many Seoul residents read each language, and says nothing about interpretation, signage or accessibility obligations at a hired venue.
value.published_channels: The quoted release names the five telephone languages, the English SMS line (02-120, weekdays 09:00-18:00), the plan to post multilingual content on the city-run Instagram and blog, AI interpretation at eleven stations, VISIT SEOUL's multilingual pages and 서울글로벌센터 counselling.
